notes: No release before 0.5.0 may claim any of this is balanced: every magnitude in the shipped content carries tuningStatus untuned and the balance harness owns all of them -- so this file is a measurement and not a balance claim.

The universe is still degenerate in the following ways. This sweep is 100 percent passive-control and submits no god verb, which is why W52 -- moving encourageResearch from a research rate to a target-appeal term -- moved not one of its ten metrics by a single count. Nothing in packages/scenario opens a portal, so no raid runs in any committed sweep and no summon is ever created. Scribing still stops when the materials stock empties. Teaching no longer dies out once the founding grants are taught -- that note was carried by the superseded files and is now measurably false: over the reference two hundred years a lesson is taught in every one of the ten twenty-year windows, the thinnest holding 16.
